newsitem.title: USA: Brock Intl sees $2 mln oper loss in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Brock Intl sees $2 mln oper loss in Q4.

text.p: Brock International Inc said Wednesday it expects to report an operating loss of more than $2 million for the fourth quarter of 1996.
It also said it is restructuring operations to restore profitability this year.
The company said the strategic changes and staff cuts will result in a one-time charge, which it will disclose along with fourth quarter results on February 10.
The company reported a third quarter loss of $0.20 per share. Wall Street analysts had expected a loss of $0.02 per share, according to First Call estimates.
